_serviceNote: The MCP measurement-server endpoint was removed 2026-08-19: its worker returned 404 and a DID document must not advertise dead services. It returns in the same commit that redeploys it.

_keyContinuity.note: Two signing identities per KEY-CONTINUITY.md (binding estate note, 2026-08-16). #site-release-1 signs site deploys, release cards and agent cards (keystone-held). #estate-chain-1 signs fleet board chains and measurement cards (pod-held). Public verify surfaces label which key signed each artifact. Ed25519 today; ML-DSA-65 is roadmap, not present. #card-attestation-1 (added 2026-08-20) signs the mine's measurement-card generation (d4cb0eaa, Mac-held estate key) - the cards' actual signer, published so the 335-card chain verifies against the trust root.

superseded.reason: Published 2026-08-17 from a generation script, not from the production keystone; no estate artifact was ever validly signed with this key and its private half is not held. Superseded per KEY-CONTINUITY rule 4. Any artifact claiming this key and not verifiable against the two keys above is not ours.

_boardAttestationNote: #board-attestation-1 signs the PUBLIC BOARD SNAPSHOT as served by the site (integrity of /api/gspc), distinct from #estate-chain-1 which signs pod measurement chains. Born and held in Cloudflare; the private half never leaves.
_gspcBoardKeyNote: #gspc-board-22axis-2026 is the 3-party Coinbase cb-mpc Ed25519 additive key that signs public/signed/gspc-board.signed.json. The private scalar never exists as a whole number; three shares on the owner's Oracle tenancy produce a stock RFC 8032 signature. JWK x is the raw 32-byte public key d573a7219c0d645091e9f640cb5bbfe71429d43ac168568665a7a260d01e0d2c in base64url. Distinct from #board-attestation-1 (3KB living stamp / Pages card-sign). This fragment is published so a stranger can pin the freeze key independently of the file that carries the signature. did:web resolution of this id is https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json — the same fragment must appear there for DID pin, not only on this councilof.ai copy.
_pqcNote: #board-pqc-1 ABSENT (UNMEASURED). No ML-DSA public key is published in this document. Do not generate one off-keystone. ML-DSA-65 signatures are ~3.3KB and cannot live inside the 3KB card atom. Hybrid is a second receipt on root/DID, never inside the card. Ed25519 is not replaced. PQCBench is the GSPC continuity arena (csoai/gspc-asi), not a PQC signature.
